item.title: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Friday, May 1st, 2026, and welcome to your Daily Driv...
item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Friday, May 1st, 2026, and welcome to your Daily Drive. We've got a gorgeous autumn day ahead, perfect for enjoying the last of the sunshine before the weekend, and it's also International Workers' Day globally. Did you know the iconic Sydney Harbour Bridge celebrates its 94th birthday next month? Let's power through this Friday and make it a brilliant start to the long weekend!
